items.summary: Persist the admin wallet balance in stable canister state so that it starts at 10,000 PKR on first install and does not reset to 0 (or reinitialize) after canister upgrades/redeployments.

Ensure the admin wallet does not become inaccessible due to missing admin initialization: the backend must reliably recognize the intended admin principal(s) so that admin-only methods (e.g., getAdminWalletBalance, getAllOrders, updateOrderStatus, distributeFunds) work for the admin account used by the app.

Update the BalanceIndicator admin wallet display logic so it never misleadingly shows “0 PKR” when the admin wallet query fails or is unavailable; instead, show a clear English UI state (e.g., “Admin Wallet: Unavailable” or an error message) for admins, and continue to hide the admin wallet section for non-admin users without surfacing errors.

Update the Admin page (/admin) wallet-balance card so that it reflects the real persisted admin wallet balance when available and shows a clear English message when the admin wallet balance is unavailable (instead of defaulting to 0).
